body:
Reported on 1.14.0: pulling down on an expenses list does nothing. On shopping and
checklist lists the same gesture resyncs. The expense list screen is a screen of its
own (T-154) and did not get the pull-to-refresh wrapper the list screen has.

Wanted: the same gesture, the same indicator, the same sync call as the other lists.
title: android: pull-to-refresh is missing on the expense list screen
